title: メディアデザイン
subtitle: Media Design
educationalGoal: This course introduces excellent examples of design and art using media technology from the early 20th century to the most advanced 21st century cases. Its purpose is to help students to understand how to use media technology in order to create design value. In addition, students will acquire the basic methods of visual expression and interactive expression using codes.
advice: In this course, students will: 1) Understand the basic methods of visual expression and interactive expression using codes. 2) Acquire mathematical concepts such as symmetry, the Fibonacci Sequence, and the Golden Ratio, which are the basics of visual expression, and then practice visual expression based on those concepts. 3) Acquire generative algorithms of shapes of natural objects, such as petal arrangement, tree and river branching, snow crystals, etc., and practice visual expression based on those concepts. 4) Create original image expressions by coding.
requiredKnowledge: Programming skill is required. Drawing experience using a paint software application is necessary.
